text:
I dont think theres an instant procrastination cure but imo the more u can wake up and just immediately start doing unpleasant shit the better

like u get out of bed and before u can even think, all ur workout gear is right there, coffee, something light to eat, and then ur on the squat rack or overhead press or pullup bar

again over 3-6 months u can hardcode any shit like this

like u get up, blink, and suddenly ur in the gym like "wtf, how did I get here"

after that the rest of the day sort of feels easier

the later u push unpleasant tasks into the day, the more room u give ur mind to wiggle out of it

dont allow that motherfucker an inch lol

"no quarter asked, none given" ⚔️
